in_marathi.name: Gashmeer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who has the strength of a mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gashmeer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gashmeer is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gashma' which means 'mountain'. This name signifies strength and the ability to overcome challenges, just like a mountain that stands firm against the test of time. It is also associated with wisdom and intelligence.
